## Files written (all inside `ball3d/`, no parent file touched)

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `ball3d/score.py` | pure-stdlib parse/validate, pitch model (`middle 1 = C = MIDI 60`), absolute-time event list, board layout, analytic motion (`sample_ball` / `sample_track`) |
| `ball3d/audio.py` | synthesized melody (partials + board tick) → 16-bit WAV, onset at `round(t*sr)` |
| `ball3d/render_scene.py` | Blender 4.5 / `BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT` scene: boards with thickness, support posts, big neutral floor, low sun (long shadows), pearl ball, 8-octahedron star burst per landing, compositor Glare glow, oblique follow camera; frames sampled at exactly `frame_index/fps` |
| `ball3d/make_ball_video.py` | CLI: validate → plan → WAV → Blender subprocess → ffmpeg H.264/yuv420p+AAC mux; `--seconds`, `--output`, `--blender`, `--plan-only`, bounded `--batch/--limit` |
| `ball3d/tests/test_score.py` | 24 tests: fixture counts/timing, rests, transposition, octave, repeats, invalid timing, onset accumulation, board collision, continuity, no-teleport bound, ≤1-sample audio onset, ≤1-frame sampling, WAV metadata |
| `ball3d/README.md` | deps, exact commands, input contract, timing/motion model, limitations (incl. why lyric text is omitted) |

Expected on the fixture: 13 lines, 377 events = 335 sounding + 42 rests, `sum q = 188`, tempo 65, score 173.538 s, first landing at lead (1.2 s by default). Frames land in `ball3d/out/<name>.work/frames/frame_%06d.png` (kept for inspection; `--clean` removes them).

Known unverified spots the reviewer should watch: Blender 4.5 API names (`CompositorNodeGlare`, `BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT`, `-noaudio`), EEVEE's GPU requirement in background mode, and per-board material count (~335 unique materials) which may make shader compilation the slow part of a render.
